nodes.label: ADR 0020: Dispute Handling Workflow
nodes.rationale: Triple-delivery on every dispute event (charge.dispute.created/updated/closed/funds_reinstated/funds_withdrawn): (1) tenant email via Resend to org owner (informational events skip email), (2) tenant in-app notification row in tenant DB, (3) platform admin queue UPSERT in control-panel platform_dispute_queue keyed on dispute_id. Each side effect independently try/caught. Webhook handler always returns 200. Evidence submission stays in Stripe Dashboard for v1.
alternatives_rejected: In-app evidence submission UI (high effort, Stripe Dashboard already production-grade)
Dispute row per event (admins want current state, not event history)
Slack alerting (deferred to future Plan C v2)
